items.title: What is Antigravity Declarative UI?
items.content: It is an architecture where UI structure, data transformations, and rendering behavior are 100% defined in declarative JSON specifications rather than imperative code.

items.title: How does spec-repo work?
items.content: spec-repo acts as the single source of truth for all HTML specs, assembly instructions, and component definitions across the entire ecosystem.

items.title: Can new components be added without writing JavaScript?
items.content: Yes! Adding a new component (like this accordion, cards, or menus) only requires defining the template in spec.json, the recipe in instructions.json, and the blueprint in definitions.json.
